name: Sucrose (C12H22O11), refined table sugar
source: Sucrose molar mass 342.297 g/mol from IUPAC standard atomic weights (C 12.011 x12, H 1.008 x22, O 15.999 x11).
notes: Refined sucrose is essentially the pure compound (food-grade sugar is >99.9% sucrose); C and H are rounded to the nearest microgram and O absorbs the remainder so the three-element compound closes exactly.
